_comment: pydyn's scope: Dynare features pydyn has decided not to implement (for now). A test listed here that pydyn REFUSES is `excluded` in the comparison report (feature and reason shown); one pydyn runs is compared normally and flagged. Format and rules: docs/ACCEPTANCE.md, rule 6. To park another feature add an entry {feature, reason, ids (test ids or fnmatch patterns such as 'method_of_moments/*'), expect (optional regex of the refusal message)}. Per-port: another port keeps its own file.

entries.feature: parameter derivatives of the order-2/3 solution and the pruned state space (identification at order > 1, get_perturbation_params_derivs at order > 1)
entries.reason: parked by decision: low priority, identification at order 1 covers the usual use

entries.feature: semi-structural model tools: equation-by-equation estimation (dyn_ols, sur, pooled_ols, pooled_fgls, olsgibbs, surgibbs), cherrypick and the equation.* package, which share Dynare's JSON equation parser (matlab/ols, about 1,800 lines, plus cherrypick.m, 525 lines)
entries.reason: for semi-structural models: parked by decision, not used in the DSGE workflow pydyn targets
